shot_vocabulary: close-up or extreme close-up on a single detail (an eye, a hand reaching, an empty spot where the toy should be)
medium-close, widening slightly from the conflict beat's close framing
lens_vocabulary: 35mm equivalent (slightly wider, shows character + immediate environment)
movement_vocabulary: gentle tracking shot following the character's movement
slow pull-back or static — lets the moment breathe
slow push-in, or static — never a whip or fast pan here
static or very slow drift — stability keeps this from reading as scary, per DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md's no-fear rule
static — group stillness reinforces the calm-close pattern from ending_styles.json's family/dua endings
very slow push-in or static — the tightness itself creates the hook, not motion

composition_rules.intimate_emotional_moment: rule of thirds, character's eyes on the upper third line
composition_rules.conflict_introduction: character slightly off-center, negative space toward whatever is causing the problem
composition_rules.effort_action: character in motion, rule of thirds with movement direction leading into open space
composition_rules.resolution_relief: centered or rule-of-thirds, more open space around the character showing calm
composition_rules.group_family_moment: characters grouped closely, symmetrical or gently rule-of-thirds balanced
composition_rules.curiosity_hook_opening: tight, off-center, deliberately incomplete (viewer wants to see more)

intimate_emotional_moment.example_use: Child making dua, a quiet realization, a hug
intimate_emotional_moment.lighting: warm, soft key light, golden-hour tone
intimate_emotional_moment.composition: rule of thirds, character's eyes on the upper third line
intimate_emotional_moment.movement: slow push-in, or static — never a whip or fast pan here
intimate_emotional_moment.color_palette: Warm cream, soft gold, dusty rose — low saturation, high warmth
intimate_emotional_moment.depth_of_field: Shallow — soft-focused background, character in sharp focus

conflict_introduction.example_use: Character first notices the problem (e.g. toy is missing)
conflict_introduction.lens: 35mm equivalent (slightly wider, shows character + immediate environment)
conflict_introduction.lighting: neutral daylight, slightly cooler than the resolution beat to signal mild tension
conflict_introduction.composition: character slightly off-center, negative space toward whatever is causing the problem
conflict_introduction.movement: static or very slow drift — stability keeps this from reading as scary, per DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md's no-fear rule
conflict_introduction.color_palette: Muted sage green, cool cream, soft grey undertones
conflict_introduction.depth_of_field: Medium — background readable but not competing for attention

effort_action.example_use: Character actively searching, trying, or working at something
effort_action.composition: character in motion, rule of thirds with movement direction leading into open space
effort_action.movement: gentle tracking shot following the character's movement
effort_action.color_palette: Bright peach, warm mint, sunlit cream
effort_action.depth_of_field: Medium-deep — environment visible to show the search/effort in context

resolution_relief.example_use: Problem resolves, character relaxes, family reunites
resolution_relief.camera: medium-close, widening slightly from the conflict beat's close framing
resolution_relief.lighting: warm, golden, slightly brighter than the conflict beat
resolution_relief.composition: centered or rule-of-thirds, more open space around the character showing calm
resolution_relief.movement: slow pull-back or static — lets the moment breathe
resolution_relief.color_palette: Golden amber, warm cream, soft lavender
resolution_relief.depth_of_field: Shallow — mirrors the intimate_emotional_moment's focus pull inward

group_family_moment.example_use: Family together, dua said as a group, closing beat
group_family_moment.lighting: warm, even, soft — no harsh shadows
group_family_moment.composition: characters grouped closely, symmetrical or gently rule-of-thirds balanced
group_family_moment.movement: static — group stillness reinforces the calm-close pattern from ending_styles.json's family/dua endings
group_family_moment.color_palette: Full warm palette — cream, peach, sage, lavender balanced evenly
group_family_moment.depth_of_field: Deep — everyone and the room both in focus, nothing isolated

curiosity_hook_opening.example_use: The first 3-8 seconds of an episode or Short
curiosity_hook_opening.camera: close-up or extreme close-up on a single detail (an eye, a hand reaching, an empty spot where the toy should be)
curiosity_hook_opening.lighting: matches the scene's actual time of day, slightly higher contrast to grab attention
curiosity_hook_opening.composition: tight, off-center, deliberately incomplete (viewer wants to see more)
curiosity_hook_opening.movement: very slow push-in or static — the tightness itself creates the hook, not motion
curiosity_hook_opening.color_palette: High-contrast single accent color against neutral cream background
curiosity_hook_opening.depth_of_field: Very shallow — near-macro focus on the single detail

transition_rules.note: Not present in source data (camera_language.json covers per-shot rules, not cut/transition rules between shots). Flagged for authoring input.
